description: This PHP class 'Composer' manages AWS SDK service cleanup tasks, including removing unused AWS service directories based on configuration and environment.

classes.name: Composer
classes.description: A class providing static methods to remove unused AWS SDK services based on project configuration and environment.

methods.name: removeUnusedServicesInDev
methods.description: Removes unused services in development environment.

methods.name: removeUnusedServices
methods.description: Removes unused services in non-development environment.

methods.name: removeUnusedServicesWithConfig
methods.description: Core method that performs the removal of unused services based on configuration and environment.

methods.name: buildServiceMapping
methods.description: Builds a mapping of service namespaces to service names from a manifest file.

methods.name: verifyListedServices
methods.description: Validates that listed services are valid AWS service namespaces.

methods.name: removeServiceDirs
methods.description: Removes directories of services that are not listed or deemed unsafe for deletion.
